baseline.name: v19 development predictions
baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then (1 - 0.7) * that + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all (out-of-sample per fold) on every row outside LIRF, then 0.3 * v9 + 0.7 * ens_v21_lgb_lirf3 on matched LIRF non-population rows with ordinary clocks, floored; reproduces 330.302 / 269.512 / 191.878 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025 (runs/adsb_v21_v2/selection.json, lirf_ens3_70). The baseline uses the recorded single-seed v12 development residual (parent v12_development_residuals); the residual model refitted here is the same single booster, so the reproduction candidate is exact.

note: December is out-of-sample for every model here; this is an honest single-month read, not a selection under the declared rule.
